name: 8624-longdecode-llama3-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct -- a re-upload of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, not a substitution; the Meta Llama 3 Community License applies. Same weights, same config, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, 8192 trained positions, bf16 weights (~16 GB) and bf16 KV cache.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 8 req/s, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 2400 requests with a 900 s safety cap. In-flight depth is unbounded; at this rate the server settles at roughly 50 requests.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompts centred on 2048 tokens (stdev 1182, clamped 64-4096) and generations centred on 256 tokens (stdev 148, clamped 16-512). Every request carries `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0` in `spec.backend.extras.body`, so a generation runs to its sampled length. Seed 42.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant generating long replies to page-length prompts at eight requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang ServerArgs for this item. Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the
# flat parser, and the engine then runs without the key at rc=0.

# NousResearch's re-upload of `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct` (Meta Llama 3 Community
# License). Same weights, same config, already in the local cache.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# Named rather than left to the auto-selector: unset, this engine picks `fa3` for a Llama-class
# model on Hopper, which is a different backend serving different kernels.
attention-backend: flashinfer

# The model's own trained window. Prompt max 4096 + output max 512 fits inside it, so no request
# is truncated and no position is extrapolated.
context-length: 8192

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
